title: Al-Ashbah wa al-Naza'ir (al-Subki)
author: taj-al-din-al-subki
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Taj al-Din al-Subki's collection of the maxims of Shafi'i law, from 'certainty is not removed by doubt' onward, with the theoretical and grammatical principles that bear on legal reasoning.
historicalContext: Al-Subki was chief judge of Damascus and the author of the great biographical dictionary of the Shafi'is. His book stands between al-Qarafi's al-Furuq and al-Suyuti's later collection in the development of the genre.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
